name: ctxd
description: Keep agents connected to changing source content with the local ctxd tracker and MCP bridge.

interface.longDescription: Use ctxd to synchronize source changes, inspect paths and read the current source through a local MCP bridge. Includes a setup and verification workflow for the released Python package.

Read the current project guide through ctxd.
